name: 김홍도 필 풍속도 화첩
name_en: Album of Genre Paintings by Kim Hong-do (Danwon)
official_name_en: Album of Genre Paintings by Kim Hong-do
material_en: Ink and light color on paper
description: 김홍도의 풍속도첩은 노동과 놀이, 유머와 움직임을 히어로 목록 안으로 끌어옵니다.
description_en: Kim Hong-do’s genre album brings labor, play, humor, and movement into the hero sequence.
hook: After kings and Buddhas, ordinary people take the stage.
